    • getIngresosAnuales

      @Query(value=" SELECT SUM(c.total)\n FROM compra c\n WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\n AND YEAR(c.fecha) = YEAR(CURDATE())\n", nativeQuery=true) Double getIngresosAnuales()

    • getTotalComprasAnuales

      @Query(value=" SELECT COUNT(*)\n FROM compra c\n WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\n AND YEAR(c.fecha) = YEAR(CURDATE())\n", nativeQuery=true) Long getTotalComprasAnuales()

    • findIngresosMensuales

      @Query("SELECT new com.application.presentation.dto.grafica.EstadisticasMensualesResponse(YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha), SUM(c.total), 0.0) FROM Compra c WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO' GROUP BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha) ORDER BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha)") List<EstadisticasMensualesResponse> findIngresosMensuales()

    • findVentasPorEstadoUltimos12Meses

      @Query(" SELECT new com.application.presentation.dto.grafica.ventasTotales.VentasPorEstadoDTO(\n CAST(c.estado AS string),\n COUNT(c),\n SUM(c.total)\n )\n FROM Compra c\n WHERE c.fecha >= :fechaInicio\n GROUP BY c.estado\n") List<VentasPorEstadoDTO> findVentasPorEstadoUltimos12Meses(@Param("fechaInicio") LocalDateTime fechaInicio)

    • findVentasPorCiudad

      @Query("SELECT new com.application.presentation.dto.grafica.ventasCiudades.VentasCiudadDTO(e.ciudad, COUNT(DISTINCT c.compraId), SUM(dv.cantidad), COUNT(DISTINCT e.empresaId)) FROM Compra c JOIN c.usuario u JOIN u.empresa e JOIN c.detalleVentas dv WHERE c.fecha >= :fechaInicio AND c.estado = 'PAGADO' AND e.ciudad IS NOT NULL AND e.ciudad != '' GROUP BY e.ciudad ORDER BY SUM(dv.cantidad) DESC") List<VentasCiudadDTO> findVentasPorCiudad(@Param("fechaInicio") LocalDateTime fechaInicio)

    • findVentasAnuales

      @Query("SELECT new com.application.presentation.dto.grafica.historicoVentas.VentasAnualesDTO(YEAR(c.fecha), COUNT(c), SUM(c.total), SUM(c.subtotal), SUM(c.iva)) FROM Compra c WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO' GROUP BY YEAR(c.fecha) ORDER BY YEAR(c.fecha) ASC") List<VentasAnualesDTO> findVentasAnuales()

    • findIngresosSemestreActual

      @Query(" SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.total), 0)\n FROM Compra c\n WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\n AND YEAR(c.fecha) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)\n AND MONTH(c.fecha) BETWEEN 1 AND 6\n") Double findIngresosSemestreActual()

    • findIngresosSemestreAnterior

      @Query(" SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.total), 0)\n FROM Compra c WHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\n AND YEAR(c.fecha) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1\n AND MONTH(c.fecha) BETWEEN 7 AND 12\n") Double findIngresosSemestreAnterior()

    • findDatosParaPrediccion

      @Query(value="SELECT\n c.total AS venta_total,\n YEAR(c.fecha) AS a\u00f1o,\n MONTH(c.fecha) AS mes,\n DAY(c.fecha) AS dia,\n DAYOFWEEK(c.fecha) AS dia_semana,\n COUNT(dv.detalle_venta_id) AS cantidad_productos,\n SUM(dv.cantidad) AS total_unidades,\n AVG(dv.precio_unitario) AS precio_promedio,\n u.usuario_id,\n CASE\n WHEN c.metodo_pago = 'TARJETA_CREDITO' THEN 1\n WHEN c.metodo_pago = 'TARJETA_DEBITO' THEN 2\n WHEN c.metodo_pago = 'MERCADO_PAGO' THEN 3\n ELSE 4\n END AS metodo_pago_num,\n CASE\n WHEN MONTH(c.fecha) IN (12,1,2) THEN 1\n WHEN MONTH(c.fecha) IN (6,7) THEN 2\n ELSE 3\n END AS temporada\nFROM compra c\nINNER JOIN detalle_venta dv ON c.compra_id = dv.compra_id\nINNER JOIN usuario u ON c.usuario_id = u.usuario_id\nWHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\nAND c.fecha >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)\nGROUP BY c.compra_id\nORDER BY c.fecha\n", nativeQuery=true) List<Object[]> findDatosParaPrediccion()

    • findVentasMensuales

      @Query(value="SELECT\n YEAR(c.fecha) as a\u00f1o,\n MONTH(c.fecha) as mes,\n SUM(c.total) as total\nFROM compra c\nWHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\nGROUP BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha)\nORDER BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha)\n", nativeQuery=true) List<Object[]> findVentasMensuales()

    • findVentasPorRangoDeAnios

      @Query(value="SELECT\n YEAR(c.fecha) as a\u00f1o,\n MONTH(c.fecha) as mes,\n SUM(c.total) as total\nFROM compra c\nWHERE c.estado = 'PAGADO'\nAND YEAR(c.fecha) BETWEEN :startYear AND :endYear\nGROUP BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha)\nORDER BY YEAR(c.fecha), MONTH(c.fecha)\n", nativeQuery=true) List<Object[]> findVentasPorRangoDeAnios(@Param("startYear") int startYear, @Param("endYear") int endYear)
